<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

In the terminal, `import` reads the file from the folder the program runs in. In the Pad, open the .jff file first (Files → Open file…); it is then found by its tab name.

## Example

```delta error
import "missing.jff"
```
